question: Bisakah paket JavaScript @wokwi/elements dipakai langsung di aplikasi Rust/egui?
probes: catalog.rs transcribes wokwi pin tables as Rust constants
Cargo.toml has only eframe, egui and image
resolution: The JavaScript Lit package @wokwi/elements cannot be used directly in a Rust egui app. The same open-source pin data is transcribed as static Rust tables in catalog.rs instead, so no JS runtime is needed.
